reissue.why: AUDIT-FINDINGS-20260731 J01: `pet-fullevent-fps-v1` is defined by FULL_EVENT_FEATURE_CONTRACT.md as the FULL-schema publication estimator (full muon object + reco vertex + view/timing), while `pet-reduced-fps-cross` is the {pT,p_parallel} estimator marked 'CROSS-CHECK ONLY -- never a publication lateral/central source'. The loader read the reduced set, the extension arrays the G2 dump carries were referenced nowhere, and the driver stamped the full-schema fingerprint on the result. The loader now reads the full event; the driver and validator move with it, which voids the bindings of every file the 2026-08-01 receipt froze. No physics was re-run: Gate-4 is PASS_CODE_ONLY and has still never run at runtime.
reissue.never_hand_edited_a_hash: The 2026-08-01 receipt's bindings are preserved verbatim in its own `files_at_issue` block (renamed so the verifier's collector no longer treats them as live) and every old->new move is recorded in `binding_moves` below. Its 07-31 and 07-21 predecessors stay superseded. NOTE FOR THE NEXT RE-ISSUE, learned by getting it wrong here first: what makes a superseded block inert is renaming each ENTRY's key `sha256` -> `sha256_at_issue`, not renaming the containing `files` block. `verify_hash_bindings.collect` recurses over the whole document and pairs any dict carrying both `path` and `sha256`, so a renamed block whose entries still say `sha256` stays live and the superseded receipt goes on reporting mismatches against the working tree. The 07-21 and 07-31 supersedes get this right; their prose ('renamed so the verifier's collector no longer treats them as live') describes the block rather than the key and reads as though either would do.

reissue.scope_of_the_edit: The estimator's INPUT SPACE changed, so unlike the J10 re-issue this is not a plumbing change and must not be read as one. The step-1 classifier is now conditioned on thirteen event features instead of two, the reco cloud carries five token columns instead of three, and the Stay-Positive refinement is fitted in the widened space. Any number produced by the previous configuration is a number from a DIFFERENT estimator -- correctly labelled `pet-reduced-fps-cross`, never `pet-fullevent-fps-v1`.

additive_bindings.J01_J02_full_event_schema: `extract_fullevent_fps.py` is new and is the extraction path for the result this gate gates -- J02 found there was no full-event extractor in the tree at all and that the recoil/5D one is not it (wrong key, `weights_push` vs `w_push`, and wrong coverage, 2M vs arange(49152885)). Binding it here is the same zero-cost move B-1 and B-6 made: a gate whose result cannot be extracted without a script should be able to detect that the script changed. `test_fullevent_schema.py` and `test_fullevent_extract.py` are the new tests. `make_synthetic_g2_fullevent.py` is bound because its muon block silently disagreed with the dumper's column order for as long as nothing read it, and it is now the fixture the full-event path is exercised against off-cluster.

code_fixes_in_this_reissue.J01_the_full_event_is_read: `fullevent_fps_dataloader` consumes every G2 extension array. reco_view/reco_time (and the data/bkg twins) become token columns 3,4 of the reco cloud, re-zeroed from the energy pad mask rather than trusted. reco_muon/reco_vertex (and twins) become event features, with the azimuth encoded as (cos phi, sin phi) -- the CLM-008 F10 periodicity fix, one level up from the truth cloud -- and q/p taking the reciprocal unit convention so the +1e-6 standard-deviation floor is not a 1% squeeze on that column alone. The reco and truth schemas are now genuinely distinct in width, enforced by TRUTH_ELIGIBLE_FEATURES refusing a detector quantity on the truth leg at construction time.
code_fixes_in_this_reissue.J05_refiner_feature_space: The Stay-Positive refinement g(x)=D/(D+B) is fitted on the same normalized event block the step-1 classifier is conditioned on, instead of on (pT,p_parallel) alone with the refined weights then attached to cloud-plus-event space. B-5/J05 is NARROWED, not closed: the per-token recoil cloud, including the new view/time columns, is still outside a tabular refiner's design matrix, and meta['target']['refinement_feature_space'] says so in the receipt rather than in a comment.
code_fixes_in_this_reissue.J02_full_event_extractor: `extract_fullevent_fps.py`, in two stages. `push` rebuilds the trained step-2 network from the driver's `inference_contract` and streams the FULL 49,152,885-row inventory through it in chunks, writing `w_push` over `arange(N)`; `xsec` turns that into the extended-FPS differential cross section. Three things it gets right that a naive reweight-all would not: the event-feature normalization is REPRODUCED from the artifact rather than re-derived over the full inventory (re-deriving it feeds the trained model a differently scaled input and returns confident wrong weights); the reweight is the ENGINE's own `MultiFold.reweight`, invoked on a minimal instance so the F3 logit cap and fail-closed check are one implementation as CLM-008 F3 requires, with no edit to the hash-bound engine; and it is chunked, because the full truth cloud in the widened representation is ~19 GB materialized. The extraction arithmetic is a PORT of pet_systematics_5d.PETxsec5D.xsec to the two FPS axes through the shared xsec_nd.extract_cross_section_nd, minus PETxsec5D's comp_rescale, which anchors completeness to a validated GBDT 5D product that does not exist for this domain.
code_fixes_in_this_reissue.synthetic_fixture_muon_layout: `make_synthetic_g2_fullevent._muon` built a 6-column [px,py,pz,E,charge,quality] placeholder against the dumper's 7-column [px,py,pz,E,phi,qp,minos_ok], and said so in its own docstring. It passed every G2 gate because `fullevent_dump_contract.assert_inventory_alignment` checks the muon block's ROW count and never its width. Fixed to the dumper's order, given the -9999 !pass_reco sentinel convention it also lacked, pinned against the dumper's constants by test_fullevent_schema.py, and the width is now checked where it is consumed (`assert_evt_block_widths`).
